turns.text: Is the ABHA number mandatory in /v3/link/carecontext?

must_contain: abhaNumber is not in the required list; the body requires abhaAddress and patient
If the link token was generated with both abhaNumber and abhaAddress, both are sent again when linking; otherwise one of the two is enough
When abhaNumber is sent it is 14 digits and nothing else
notes: NHA QA sample, 30 September 2026: 'Some parts are correct otherwise unnecessary informations has been provided. It is not providing the exact clarity for this particular situation.' Verdict group: wrong shape for the question. A yes or no question was answered with two routes and three steps. The case asserts only the required list and the token rule; whether this path is a call or a callback is in dispute with NHA and is not asserted.
